source.author: verg
source.text: Verum haec ipse equidem spatiis exclusus iniquis praetereo atque aliis post me memoranda relinquo.
source.text_original: Verum haec ipse equidem spatiis exclusus iniquis / praetereo atque aliis post me memoranda relinquo.
source.text_english: But these matters, for my part, shut out by the narrow limits, I pass over and leave to others to remember after me.

reuse.author: hier
reuse.text: Verum haec ipse equidem spatiis exclusus iniquis praetereo atque aliis post me memoranda relinquo.
reuse.text_original: Verum haec ipse equidem spatiis exclusus iniquis praetereo atque aliis post (me) memoranda relinquo.
reuse.text_english: But I myself, indeed shut out by unfair limits of space, pass over these matters and leave them to be remembered by others after me.
